description: This file defines the interface RetrieveFeatureLiveCommand, which extends multiple other interfaces related to live commands, feature identification, and query commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It serves as a live command interface for retrieving features, providing access to command details and answer builders.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command for retrieving features, combining behavior of live command, query, and feature identification, and capable of providing answer builders.

methods.description: Constructor or interface declaration for the RetrieveFeatureLiveCommand, extending multiple interfaces to provide a comprehensive live command functionality.
